fields.headline: GPS guidance accuracy reduced: stop precision work until further notice
fields.observed: Members report guidance drifting by 8 to 12 feet on RTK-corrected systems since late last night. Correction signals show fewer satellites and frequent loss of fixed solution.
advice: Stop planting and spraying that depends on GNSS guidance.
Switch to manual steering and visual markers where work cannot wait.
Do not recalibrate receivers during the disturbance; errors may return.
fields.duration: Disturbances can continue for one to several days and may be worse after dark.
fields.nextUpdate: We will update at noon and again at 6 PM.
fields.footer: Exercise notice. The cooperative is fictional.
